correctness.rationale: Line-graph translation makes selected edges vertex-disjoint P3s and isolated edges, giving 4k cap on 6k endpoints. Equality is a P3-factor with k centers each side. Every nontrivial two-swap either exchanges chosen same-orientation leaves, giving 8*binom(k,2), or switches cross-orientation centers, giving 4k^2. The leaf-swap fiber is connected; the quotient contains the connected direct product of two nonbipartite Johnson graphs, establishing connectivity. Independent enumeration of all n=3 maximum sets yields 9 optimums, no one-swap, connected degree-four two-swap graph.
